Array of 4 policy objects with shape: ```ts interface Policy { icon: LucideIcon; title: string; body: string; } ``` | # | icon | title | body | |---|---|---|---| | 0 | `CreditCard` | `"Reserva con Seña"` | `"La reserva se confirma abonando el 30% de la estadía."` | | 1 | `CalendarX` | `"Sin Reembolso"` | `"Una vez señada la reserva no se realiza reembolso. La fecha puede reprogramarse; el precio puede variar según la fecha elegida."` | | 2 | `PawPrint` | `"Mascotas Bienvenidas"` | `"Aceptamos todo tipo de mascotas, sin límite de cantidad."` | | 3 | `Clock` | `"Check-in / Check-out"` | `"Check-in: 12:00 hs. Check-out: 10:00 hs. Late check-out disponible con costo adicional, consultanos."` | --- ## Layout Spec ```
// py-20 px-4, bg-muted/30

Políticas

// font-playfair, text-4xl md:text-5xl, font-bold, mb-6

Todo lo que necesitás saber antes de reservar

// subtitle, text-muted-foreground {policies.map(policy => ( // wrapper: bg-white rounded-lg border hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/20 {policy.title} {policy.body} ))}
``` **Key Tailwind classes:** - Section wrapper: `py-20 px-4 bg-muted/30` - Container: `max-w-4xl mx-auto` - Heading `

`: `font-[family-name:var(--font-playfair)] text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold mb-6` - AccordionItem wrapper div: `bg-white rounded-lg border hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/20 mb-3` (consistent with FAQSection) - Icon inside trigger: `h-6 w-6 text-primary mr-3 shrink-0` - Accordion type: `"single"` with `collapsible` prop (only one item open at a time) --- ## Integration Spec ### page.tsx **File:** `app/page.tsx` 1. Add import at top of file alongside other section imports: ```ts import { PoliciesSection } from "@/components/sections/policies-section"; ``` 2. Locate the existing `
` block and the immediately following ``. Insert the new block **between** them: ```tsx
``` **Section id `"politicas"` lives on the wrapper `
` in `page.tsx`, not inside `PoliciesSection` itself.** ### floating-navbar.tsx **File:** `components/floating-navbar.tsx` (or equivalent path) Add `{ label: "Políticas", id: "politicas" }` to the `navItems` array **after** the `"Disponibilidad"` entry (current index 3 → new index 4): ```ts const navItems = [ // ... existing items 0-3 ... { label: "Disponibilidad", id: "disponibilidad" }, // index 3 (unchanged) { label: "Políticas", id: "politicas" }, // index 4 (NEW) // ... remaining items shift by 1 ... ]; ``` The nav item must appear in both the desktop bar and the mobile dropdown menu — no conditional rendering required if `navItems` is already iterated uniformly for both views. --- ## Acceptance Scenarios | ID | Scenario | Given | When | Then | |---|---|---|---|---| | SC-01 | Section renders with heading | Page loads | PoliciesSection mounts | Heading "Políticas" present using Playfair Display font; subtitle "Todo lo que necesitás saber antes de reservar" visible | | SC-02 | All 4 policies rendered as accordion items | Section renders | — | 4 AccordionItems present; each trigger shows its policy title; all content collapsed by default | | SC-03 | Accordion expand/collapse | 4 items rendered | User clicks an AccordionTrigger | Content expands showing policy body; clicking again collapses it; only one item open at a time (`type="single"`) | | SC-04 | Icons present | Section renders | — | Each trigger shows its lucide-react icon (`h-6 w-6 text-primary`) alongside the title | | SC-05 | Nav link present and functional | Page loads | User clicks "Políticas" in floating navbar | `scrollToSection("politicas")` is called; viewport scrolls to `id="politicas"` | | SC-06 | Visual consistency | Section renders | — | Background `bg-muted/30`; spacing `py-20 px-4`; accordion items use `bg-white rounded-lg border hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/20` | | SC-07 | Mobile responsive | Viewport < md breakpoint | Section and nav render | Section is full-width single column; "Políticas" nav item present in mobile dropdown | | SC-08 | No TypeScript errors | Implementation complete | `tsc --noEmit` runs | Zero new type errors | --- ## Non-functional Requirements - **Accessibility:** Accordion is built on Radix UI primitives — keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes (aria-expanded, aria-controls) are provided out of the box. No additional aria work required. - **Dependencies:** No new packages. All imports (`shadcn/ui accordion`, `lucide-react`, `AnimatedSection`) are already present in the project. - **Data:** Fully static — no API calls, no backend, no async loading. - **Performance:** No lazy loading required; component is lightweight. --- ## Constraints 1. **Scope boundary:** This change touches exactly 3 files — `components/sections/policies-section.tsx` (new), `app/page.tsx` (import + JSX insertion), `components/floating-navbar.tsx` (navItems addition).
